services.name: Jet Ski Rentals
services.desc: We’re open seasonally from Mar 1, 2023 to Nov 1, 2023. Monday - Sunday 8am to 6pm SAFETYIf you’re new to Personal Watercraft, we’ll get you checked out in no time. We’ll give you all the information you’ll need to operate our Seadoos safely. We do not rent to those under the age of 18; Minors must be accompanied by an adult on the jetski. If you’re 18 years old, you’re free to ride alone, but must possess a current Boaters License (A temporary boaters license is acceptable). Safety is our #1 priority. 15% discount for active-duty military, veterans, and first responders - I.D.
